summary: Tested the new AI Action Report feature across all 4 generation flows (proposal, contract, invoice, plan) — backend & frontend. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass, all endpoints correctly return the `report` object with expected time_saved values (23/12/6/15), confidence (88-99), steps, why (3-6), quality (4), and human type_labels. Regression: proposal save/get and plan persistence intact; /api/ai/time-saved works. Frontend: AIActionReport renders correctly after each generation with all required data-testids (report-success-title, report-checklist [8/7/6/6 items], report-time-saved with correct minutes, report-lifetime, report-confidence(-value), report-why, report-quality [4 chips], report-actions). Suggested next-step buttons visible/clickable: proposal/contract/invoice show all 5 (Review/Edit/PDF/Word/Send), plan only shows Review+Edit (as spec'd). Review button dismisses report and returns to the editor with content intact. Mobile (390px) responsive — layout stacks single-column with no overflow. No lorem/placeholder text detected; all copy is human/business-friendly.

issues: Minor cosmetic: on a wide (1920px) desktop viewport, during the 0.32s ai-pop item-stagger animation, a few checklist items can briefly appear scaled up (scale(1.25)) and visually overlap outside the left card boundary before settling. Once animations complete (~800ms) all items fit inside the card with correct bounding boxes. Not a blocker; if desired, apply overflow-hidden to the checklist card or add transform-origin:left center to stop the visual bleed.

critical_code_review_comments: build_ai_report is clean, deterministic, and free of any LLM cost — good design.
AIActionReport.jsx unconditionally calls aiApi.timeSaved() on every mount; consider caching the lifetime figure to avoid a duplicate network hit each time the user regenerates.

The `report-onSend` handler in ProposalWriter/etc. sends via proposalWriterApi.save() — works, but silently marks status Sent even if the content is a fresh unsaved draft; that's the intended UX per the spec (verified account) but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed project 5b3538af-0c6a-480e-8b11-c730368e1402 (Brand Redesign / Northwind Labs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Action Report feature is fully working end-to-end. Backend `report` object shape verified. Frontend renders and all 5 suggested-action buttons wire to the correct existing handlers. Plan report intentionally omits PDF/Word/Send buttons. Only cosmetic note is the mid-animation overflow at wide desktop viewports (self-resolves in <1s).
